text: The Sindh Flood Emergency Rehabilitation Project (SFERP) is a collaborative initiative between the Government of Sindh and the World Bank, launched in 2023 to address the aftermath of the 2022 floods in Sindh, Pakistan. The project aims to rehabilitate critical infrastructure, create short-term livelihood opportunities, and enhance provincial capacity for climate and disaster risk management. It employs a hybrid flood risk management approach that combines conventional civil works with nature-based solutions, such as wetland restoration and vegetative riverbank protection, to achieve cost-effective and durable resilience gains.
